meanings.note: Intransitive reflexive verb. Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to fight, struggle', paired with 'побороться'.

examples.text: Это будущий мэр Синеозерска! Ну что, родной мой, за тебя!

вообще-то.gloss: actually, as a matter of fact

meanings.en: actually, as a matter of fact, for the record
meanings.note: Polite or pointed correction. Prefix 'во-' ('into, up') marks inward or upward movement (stem 'обще-то'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Меня вообще-то Юля зовут. Вот сахар.
examples.trans: My name is actually Yulia. Here's the sugar.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'everything', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Я знаю всё в моём отеле.
examples.trans: I know everything in my hotel.

meanings.note: Location; for direction use 'куда'. Core Russian adv meaning 'where' in everyday speech.

examples.text: А где машинка? Где моя машинка?
examples.trans: Hey, where's the toy car? Where's my toy car?

meanings.note: + genitive. Core Russian prep meaning 'until, before; up to' in everyday speech.

meanings.en: to depend on, be contingent on (with от + genitive)
meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'висеть'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to depend on'.

examples.text: Но всё зависит только от вас.
examples.trans: But everything depends only on you.

examples.text: Соберись, экономика города зависит от тебя.
examples.trans: Pull yourself together, the city economy depends on you.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'втра').

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

издеваться.gloss: to mock, to kid, to mess with

meanings.en: to mock, to tease; colloquially 'are you kidding me?'
meanings.note: Ты что, издеваешься? = Are you kidding me?
Core Russian conj meaning 'or' in everyday speech.
вот именно = that's just it, quite right
А именно = namely. Core Russian part meaning 'exactly, namely, precisely' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Именно это я и хотел сказать.
examples.trans: That is justamente what I wanted to say.

examples.text: Вот именно. Но мне сдаваться нельзя.
examples.trans: Exactly. But I must not give up.

meanings.note: Common neuter noun meaning 'name' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Let's find out the winner's name.

examples.text: Давайте узнаем имя нашего главного победителя!
examples.trans: Let's find out the name of our grand winner!

meanings.en: sometimes, from time to time, occasionally
meanings.note: Invariable Russian adverb used to modify verbs or whole clauses with the sense 'sometimes'.

examples.text: Иногда наши победы бывают слишком странными.
examples.trans: Sometimes our victories turn out too strange.
Sometimes it is useful to trust others.

meanings.note: Prefix 'ис-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'кать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to look for'.

examples.text: Ну что, довольна? Теперь новую работу искать.
examples.trans: Well, happy now? Now I have to look for a new job.

meanings.note: наш, наша, наше, наши; agrees with the noun

meanings.note: Понял? = got it?; понял = got it. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'нять'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to understand', paired with 'понимать'.

принимать.gloss: to receive, to see (visitors); to take

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'нимать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to receive, to see (visitors); to take', paired with 'принять'.
